top_signals.title: Gold Holds Gain as Trump’s War Comments Ease Inflation Jitters
top_signals.summary: Gold held a gain as US President Donald Trump appeared to rule out prolonged military action in the Middle East, easing inflationary concerns driven by a renewed spike in energy prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Advance as Oil Slips, Yen in Focus: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks followed Wall Street higher, while oil slipped after President Donald Trump played down the prospect of a prolonged conflict with Iran. The yen remained in focus after its sudden strengthening.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Yen Surge Puts Traders on High Alert for Market Intervention
top_signals.summary: A sharp rise in the yen during New York trading has put traders back on high alert for any evidence that authorities will return to the market following intervention in July.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Inside India newsletter: India’s economic growth is smashing forecasts, but its biggest stocks aren't feeling the love
top_signals.summary: India's strong economic growth has surprised every quarter for the last year, but the performance of its key stock benchmarks has been deeply disappointing.
